shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,95p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 20 -B 3 '## Page Constructor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls -a; npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies --json; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text ThemeProvider"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text ThemeProvider && rg -n -C 5 'page-constructor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor | rg '(docs/INDEX|HeaderBlock|ExtendedFeatures|CardLayout|ContentLayout|PageConstructor|types/blocks|styles.css|package.json)' | head -65; rg -n -A 70 '"'^### Customization'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json | head -65; cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Header.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/CardLayout.md; cat vite.config.ts; rg -n 'CustomItems|CustomBlock|interface PageContent|TitleProps|HeaderBlockModel' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.css | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.js | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/components/ConstructorBlock/ConstructorBlock.js | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/blocks/header.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/BlockBase/BlockBase.css | head -90; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/CardLayout/CardLayout.css | head -70; rg -n 'dynamicImport|include|filter' node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import/README.md | head -20; rg -n -- '--pc-.*(width|gap)|--g-text-display' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/variables.scss node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/grid/Grid/Grid.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts; rg -n -A 6 'enum Theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/HTML/HTML.js | head -90; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/grid/Grid/Grid.css | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/utils.js | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/components/ConstructorItem/ConstructorItem.js | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'Button|Text|ThemeProvider|Required setup' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -65; rg -n -A 18 'CSS API' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button/README.md; npm run build > /tmp/tempo-build.log 2>&1"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js; rg -n 'from .(url|path|buffer|process|util).' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm --glob '*.js' | head -15; test -d node_modules/url && echo 'url installed'"

/bin/bash -lc "tail -18 /tmp/tempo-build.log; git status --short; rg -n 'import\\("'`|import'"\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/constructor-items.js | head -10; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/CardLayout/CardLayout.js | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.js | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc 'tail -12 /tmp/tempo-build.log; git diff --check; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.css | head -55; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/components/ConstructorRow/ConstructorRow.js | head -75'
